page_title: PIS 0-2 JUV | Pisa v Juventus 27/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' Substitution. Joao Mario (Juventus) replaces Kenan Yildiz.
90+3' Referee Fabio Maresca points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) goes wild in celebration.
90+3' The Juventus players halt their celebrations as referee Fabio Maresca makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
90+2' 0 - 2 Goal! Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) finishes from close range with an easy finish and he makes it 0:2. He was ably assisted there by Jonathan David.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
88' The shots on goal statistics – 0:5. 8:13 – the total goal attempt statistics.
87' Luciano Spalletti has decided to substitute Andrea Cambiaso and he is replaced by Filip Kostic (Juventus).
86' The manager makes a subsitution with Fabio Miretti (Juventus) coming on for Teun Koopmeiners.
86' Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Fabio Maresca had an easy-decision to make.
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Arturo Calabresi leaves the pitch and Louis Buffon (Pisa) comes on.
82' Good work from Juventus as they win a corner.
79' Alberto Gilardino prepares a substitution. Michel Aebischer is replaced by Marius Marin (Pisa).
78' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris walks off the pitch to be replaced by Lorran (Pisa).
77' Edon Zhegrova (Juventus) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but it is straight at Adrian Semper.
76' Antonio Caracciolo (Pisa) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
73' 0 - 1 Goal 0:1! Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) taps home from close range after the rebound fell kindly into his path.
72' Juventus force a corner. They send men into the box.
71' Edon Zhegrova (Juventus) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
71' The corner is swung in but Juventus can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. Juventus get a corner.
68' Wonderful movement by Juventus. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
65' Alberto Gilardino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Giovanni Bonfanti (Pisa) replacing Samuele Angori.
65' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Malthe Hojholt (Pisa) comes onto the pitch so that Isak Vural can be given a rest.
64' Lloyd Kelly (Juventus) is found in space by a decent pass, and he immediately hits a rocket of a shot at goal that clips the outside of the left post.
63' Edon Zhegrova (Juventus) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Adrian Semper has no trouble gathering it.
63' A cross from Edon Zhegrova (Juventus) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
63' The Juventus players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
61' Luciano Spalletti decides to make a substitution. Manuel Locatelli will be replaced by Edon Zhegrova (Juventus).
60' Substitution. Lois Openda did his best and is replaced by Jonathan David (Juventus).

60' Post! Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from the centre of the box wasn't accurate enough and the ball crashed against the right post!

58' A neat pass is well received by Manuel Locatelli (Juventus), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the middle of the target. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
56' The ball is out of play. Pisa will take a throw-in.
56' Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
54' An attempted cross from Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) is cleared.
53' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) has tested the patience of referee Fabio Maresca and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
52' Isak Vural (Pisa) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
51' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Idrissa Toure (Pisa). The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Pisa.
49' Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) prepares to take a corner kick.

49' Samuele Angori (Pisa) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked. The ball goes out of play. Pisa are awarded a corner kick.
48' Bremer (Juventus) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Pisa.
47' Fabio Maresca couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) and blew his whistle. A free kick is awarded to Pisa.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' Fabio Maresca has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Stefano Moreo (Pisa) leaps high to meet a lofted pass around the penalty spot, but his header crashes against the crossbar!
44' The linesman makes the right call and Pisa will have a corner.
44' Samuele Angori (Pisa) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Pisa have been awarded a corner kick.
43' Lloyd Kelly (Juventus) makes a strong challenge and Fabio Maresca blows for a foul. Pisa have a free kick.
40' Neat passing move from Juventus in order to create new attacking opportunities.
38' A pass by Idrissa Toure (Pisa) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
38' Arturo Calabresi (Pisa) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
37' The ball is behind the touchline and Pisa will take a throw-in.
37' Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
36' Lois Openda (Juventus) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.

34' The game is interrupted. Lloyd Kelly (Juventus) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. Pisa are awarded a free kick.
30' Simone Canestrelli (Pisa) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Fabio Maresca blows his whistle for a foul. Juventus are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
29' Juventus enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
28' Nice passing game by Pisa. They are increasing their possession with a series of long passes and waiting for the right moment to create an attacking opportunity.
28' It looks like Antonio Caracciolo (Pisa) saw red with that tackle. Fabio Maresca won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. A free kick to Juventus.
25' The ball is out of play. Pisa will have a throw-in.
22' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Juventus.

22' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. The linesman points to the corner flag, Juventus are going to take it.
22' Great teamplay by Pisa as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
19' Samuele Angori (Pisa) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.

18' Ooh that was close! Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) collects a pass and runs with pace goalwards before unleashing a great drive from the edge of the box, but it goes inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Pisa will have a goal kick.
18' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
14' Juventus take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
14' Weston McKennie (Juventus) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot a whisker wide of the left post. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better!
12' Juventus control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
12' Simone Canestrelli (Pisa) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Juventus in a dangerous position.
12' The Juventus players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
10' Juventus can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
10' The Pisa players are exchanging some short passes.
9' Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Fabio Maresca no option but to blow his whistle. Pisa earn a free kick.
8' Idrissa Toure (Pisa) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
6' Samuele Angori (Pisa) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
4' Pisa move the ball around well as they wait for an opportunity to shoot, but the attack is halted as they lose possession.
3' Juventus are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
3' Pisa seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
1' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) receives a pass and decides to smash the ball from long range, but his poor effort sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Pisa.
1' Juventus quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Juventus will take the kick-off.
Fabio Maresca will officiate today.
